name: Automation & AI Stack Audit Checklist
description: Structured checklist for auditing automation workflows, AI integrations, chatbot logic, and cross-system dependencies.

items.check: Trigger reliability: are all triggers firing consistently?
Error handling: does every workflow have an error path?
Data routing: are IF/Switch nodes using correct conditions?
Credentials: are all credentials valid and not expired?
Timeout settings: are HTTP nodes configured with reasonable timeouts?
Retry logic: do HTTP/API calls retry on transient failures?
Scenario structure: are scenarios modular or monolithic?
Filter logic: are filters correctly scoped to avoid data leaks?
Data store usage: are data stores indexed and not bottlenecked?
Webhook configuration: are webhooks secured with tokens or IP restrictions?
Operation budget: are scenarios staying within plan limits?
Error notifications: do failed scenarios alert someone?
Conversation flow: does the flow handle all expected user paths?
Fallback handling: what happens when the bot doesn't understand?
Context window: is conversation history managed within token limits?
Edge cases: are empty inputs, special characters, and long messages handled?
Prompt design: are prompts specific, with examples and constraints?
Response validation: are LLM outputs validated before use?
Rate limiting: are API calls rate-limited to avoid quota exhaustion?
Retrieval quality: are retrieved chunks relevant to the query?
Embedding freshness: how often is the knowledge base re-indexed?
Chunk size: are document chunks sized appropriately for the model?
Token refresh: are OAuth tokens auto-refreshed before expiry?
Credential storage: are API keys stored securely, not hardcoded?
Payload validation: are incoming webhook payloads validated?
Type consistency: are date/number/string formats consistent across systems?
Security: are webhooks protected against replay attacks?
Idempotency: can the same webhook fire twice without creating duplicates?
Acknowledgment: does the receiving system confirm receipt?
Data completeness: are all required fields present in handoff payloads?
AI integration: are AI calls async or blocking the request thread?
Error handling: are API errors caught and logged with context?
Rate limiting: are external API calls throttled appropriately?
Single points of failure: which systems have no fallback?
Dependency chain: if system A fails, which downstream systems break?
Monitoring: are failures detected automatically or only when users report them?
Bottlenecks: which integration points have the highest latency?
Concurrency: can the system handle parallel requests without conflicts?

usage: Use this checklist as a starting point for your audit. Each item includes a severity level (critical, high, medium) to help prioritize findings. Customize based on your specific systems and workflows.
